summary: RSURF-D22 (delegated, within OWNER-MINER-RESEARCH-SURFACE-03): the invariant that a person never meets the agent-facing no-campaign refusal is restated for the page's tool access. The browser doors import no research SDK (checked over their syntax tree). The page reaches research tools only through the tool door, whose adapter comes from the campaign attach (standard_cli.attached) for the campaign's own root, under its ownership lock. Every SDK that attach builds carries the campaign's ledger. With no open session, no page call reaches a tool. The demo never enters the SDK's own call. The MCP adapter stays the door that reaches the SDK directly. test_only_an_agent_can_reach_the_no_campaign_refusal is restated, and test_the_page_cannot_meet_the_no_campaign_refusal proves it by behaviour.
